title: The Midnight Alchemist’s Glass Distillery
summary: An interactive Three.js candlelit stone laboratory with boiling emerald vitriol, silver condenser coils, and glowing azure drops.
description: An interactive Three.js still life and 30-second short film set in a candlelit stone laboratory. Follow emerald vitriol from the boiling retort through a silver condenser coil, watch an azure drop strike the crystal receiver, and orbit the crowned raven skull and violet-gold tincture.
